title: Tunguska event blamed on the fire god Agdy
summary: Randall Carlson tells of Tunguska event blamed on the fire god Agdy, about 1908 at Tunguska, Siberia, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So they believed that the event was caused by their god of fire [snorts] agi coming down from heaven to punish them.

plain: A researcher named Randall Carlson says that the local people living near Tunguska in Siberia, where a huge explosion lit up the sky in 1908, believed their fire god Agdy had come down from heaven to punish them. He tells it to show how the people who saw the blast made sense of it.
